notes: Task is per-time-step binary labelling of synthetic Boolean-FSM sequences (label = parity of updated hidden state). All Table IV ablation rows share the base TM settings (240 clauses/class, T=120, s=6.0, weighted, 8 epochs, 5-member majority-vote ensemble unless the variant removes it); the tm_config schema has no field for ensemble size, fold width or EMA timescales, so the variant differences are only in the model names and the corrections above. TA state count / state bits / literal budget not stated. Timing rows (results 16-19) are host wall time including training and test, recorded with split 'test' in the record. Family-level neural means exist only in Fig. 3 (not extracted). Probe uses a 70/30 random split of test time points of the first ensemble member, not held-out sequences. Training seed values are not printed (only 'three training seeds').
